the_error: Every number reported for this family since r130 -- .4263 .5000 .5000 .5579 .5632 .5900 -- was measured on a 40-task sample that had been used for every tuning decision. It was a tuning set, not a measurement. The held-out number is 0.1519 and this is the first time it exists.

what_the_literature_says_and_i_had_alrea.arXiv 2602.07150 (On Randomness in Agent: 60,000 trajectories: ten identical full-benchmark repeats span 2.2-6.0 pp; median run-to-run SD 1.5 pp; temperature 0 does not remove it; 'improvements of 2-3 percentage points may reflect evaluation noise'. Detecting a 2 pp gain at p<0.05 needs ~9 replicates; 1 pp needs 36.
what_the_literature_says_and_i_had_alrea.arXiv 2512.06710 (Stochasticity in Agent: Var(mu) = sigma_b^2/n + sigma_w^2/(nT). With sigma_b^2/sigma_w^2 ~ 5, n=100 T=4 gives 68% lower standard error than n=10 T=40. More tasks, fewer reps.
what_the_literature_says_and_i_had_alrea.arXiv 2606.28430 (Building to the Test): with the oracle in the loop the score nears perfect while the library is left dead or absent.

why_this_matters_more_than_any_fix: r158 fixed click-option 1/12 -> 12/12, which is real and verifiable. But the total it was reported against was not a measurement, so the fix could not be placed on the total. The instrument had to be fixed before the policy.

cluster_structure_visible_in_the_blind_l.note: The blind set is not 87 independent failures. It is a small number of families. Fixing a family is the only route to a number that moves.

law_added: A benchmark sample used for any tuning decision is a tuning set forever. A held-out split must be chosen before the first fix, or the first honest number is unavailable.
